mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based consumption slowdown, which reduces corporate revenue growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-2007 housing crisis monetary easing cycle, a decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the post-2007 housing crisis period, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the real economy, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates a severe housing market collapse that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion phase, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2008 Q1 GDP growth was slowing
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when GDPC1 growth declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a severe economic downturn with aggressive monetary policy response, which reduces corporate profit expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
